description: Scaleway's OpenAPI export drops query parameters that belong to a proto `oneOf`, so `ListJobs` lose filters the API takes. The official JS SDK sends them through `resolveOneOf` in `urlParams` — scaleway-sdk-js packages_generated/qaas/src/v1alpha1/api.gen.ts — with the types in the sibling types.gen.ts. They are added as optional query members; the API enforces the one-of.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: List jobs of this session. One-of `resource_id`: at most one of `session_id`, `project_id`.
